'''{{PAGENAME}}''' were a [[Factions|faction]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Notes== *Bloodhounds wear [[Scav]] and [[Scav Raider]] clothing, but have their own voicelines. *Killing Bloodhounds as a [[Scav]] does not carry any penalties towards your Scav karma. *Bloodhounds have different health values than PMCs and Scavs. {|class="wikitable" !Bloodhound Health !Stats |- ![[File:BloodhoundsHealthOverview.png|460px]] |Head: 45 Thorax: 160 Stomach: 130 Arms: 100 each Legs: 110 each '''Total: 755''' |} *Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, they have 5 double slot pockets, bringing their total space to 10 slots. ==Quests== *30 Bloodhounds need to be killed for the quest [[Bloodhounds (quest)|Bloodhounds]]. ==Location== ====[[Customs]]==== *At the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons *At the shipping yard premises
  • File:BloodhoundSpawnsCustoms.jpg
    • ====[[Woods]]==== *At the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction) *At the dilapidated village in the north *At the Scav base (EMERCOM medical camp) *At the village in the northeast *Near the fenced off cabin southwest of the sawmill area
  • File:BloodhoundSpawnsWoods.jpg
    • ====[[Shoreline]]==== *At the hydroelectric power station *At the gas station *Western of the river in the area between the power station and the gas station *At the village in the west
  • File:BloodhoundSpawnsShoreline.jpg
    • ==Behavior== Bloodhounds appear in groups of 4-5. They patrol widely in the area they spawned. Upon contact, they rush the player. ==Strategy== Use a long range rifle and try to take them out with a headshot. Night raids with a thermal scope are a viable way to hunt them too. ==Equipment==
